verdict.rationale: Community mentions confirm Framer supports prototyping with animations/transitions and interactive, data-backed prototypes (framer-comm-2, framer-comm-4, framer-comm-5), but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation describing screen-to-screen click triggers, transition types, or overlay components — the modern-day evidence is dominated by AI agent/CMS/publishing features unrelated to this story. Missing for 10: explicit no-code trigger/transition/overlay documentation, hands-on walkthrough of wiring multiple screens, and independent confirmation the feature still exists in current product.
